title: Super-Green Pea and Mint Soup
subtitle: with Goat Cheese Toasts
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the grill to high. Line an oven tray with foil. Finely chop the onion. Peel the potato and cut into 1cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Pick the mint leaves, discarding the stems. Crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 375ml (1½ cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Cook soup: Heat 3 tsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion and half the garlic, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the potato, stock and 60ml (¼ cup) milk and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 mins or until the potato is tender.

Blend soup: Add the peas and mint to the soup and bring to the boil. Cook for 2 mins or until the peas are tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Blend the soup with a stick blender until smooth (see Kitchen 101). Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Grill toasts: Meanwhile, cut the bread rolls in half. Combine the remaining garlic and 3 tsp olive oil in a bowl. Brush the cut sides of the bread with the garlic oil. Put on the lined tray, cut-side up, and grill for 2-3 mins until lightly toasted. Spread the toasts with half the goat cheese and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Serve up: Divide the soup among bowls and serve with the goat cheese toasts. Enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Take care when blending the hot soup, as it may spit. If using a blender jug or food processor, remove the centre lid or pusher to allow the steam to escape, then hold the lid securely in place and use a tea towel to protect your hands from the heat. Don't overfill the jug – blend in batches if necessary.
